movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

movelist.name: Laser Focus
movelist.effect: The next successful damaging attack made by the user is automatically a Critical Hit.

movelist.name: Iron Head
movelist.effect: Iron Head Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Iron Defense
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

abilities.name: Dauntless Shield
abilities.effect: The user’s default Defense Combat Stages are increased by +1.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.trigger: The user uses the Sprint Action during Combat
abilities.effect: The user gains +2 Speed Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.effect: The user resists all X target ranged attacks one step further. This refers to attacks and Moves that simply hit one target or specify hitting multiple targets, such as Razor Wind hitting three targets. It has no effect on Moves that are capable of hitting multiple targets through areas of effect, such as Bursts or Cones. Defensive.
